events.title: Docker 19.03 released
events.summary: Docker Inc. released Docker Engine 19.03 on July 22, 2019 — bringing rootless mode and BuildKit as the default builder.
events.about: Docker 19.03 made multi-stage builds and faster image layers the default workflow — `docker build` with BuildKit cut CI times for millions of pipelines. Rootless mode improved security on shared developer machines.

narrative.whyChosen: Docker 19.03 made BuildKit the default, modernizing container builds.
narrative.whyImportant: It improved build speed and security for everyday Docker users.
narrative.problemSolved: Legacy Docker builds were slow and required root daemon access.
